container_adaptation.rule: content measurement wins; no essential action hidden, overflow remains keyboard accessible

tui.button.loading: busy and deduplicated, keep focus and label; do not conflate with disabled
tui.button.outline_rule: allowed on flat canvas; nested decorative outlines discouraged, necessary control boundaries retained

tui.segmented-control.semantics: single-choice value uses radio-group; panel navigation uses Tabs, not the same role
tui.segmented-control.persistent_marker: check glyph plus selected label weight, not surface difference alone

tui.disclosure.semantics: button with expanded and controls relationships
tui.disclosure.streaming: expansion remains user-controlled; status updates do not force reopen

tui.text-field.inner_composer: delegate boundary/focus to group, never remove accessible editor semantics

tui.code-block.theme_rule: no hardcoded black under light theme

tui.split-view.insufficient_width: switchable panels instead of invalid clamp

tui.scroll-area.mask: off by default; never fade text, selected content, focused controls or IC content

tui.checkbox.disabled: neutral surface and disabled-text; keep value glyph; explanation uses secondary-text
tui.checkbox.mixed: same checked roles with dash where applicable; never fake selected as checked

tui.radio-group.disabled: neutral surface and disabled-text; keep value glyph; explanation uses secondary-text
tui.radio-group.mixed: same checked roles with dash where applicable; never fake selected as checked

tui.switch.disabled: neutral surface and disabled-text; keep value glyph; explanation uses secondary-text
tui.switch.mixed: same checked roles with dash where applicable; never fake selected as checked

tui.progress.semantic_outcome: status-succeeded/status-failed are independent; progress tint does not indicate validation success

exemptions: independently interactive nested documents or sandboxes

brand_contract.theme_context: required at consumer root; all overlays inherit same resolved context

recipes.name: Composer
recipes.usage: 以20pt外壳组织附件、编辑区、工具栏；/和@由能力表驱动
recipes.prohibited: 禁止硬编码模型清单、擅自trim代码/提示词、确认落盘前清空草稿

recipes.name: Message
recipes.usage: 用户18pt浅底气泡；助手透明文档流；键盘focus也能显示操作
recipes.prohibited: 不得仅hover可操作、正文逐字模糊、复制带UI装饰

recipes.name: ThinkingSummary
recipes.usage: 公开摘要与执行状态；默认折叠并尊重用户展开选择
recipes.prohibited: 不强制重新展开；不推导或伪造内部思维链

recipes.name: Attachment
recipes.usage: 独立文件磁贴与Composer内无重复装饰框的chip
recipes.prohibited: 不把上传中当成功；不使用无许可缩略图；删除须单独可达

recipes.name: ToolDecision
recipes.usage: 动作/对象/权限/影响完整呈现，允许一次、持久规则、拒绝分离
recipes.prohibited: 不由动画完成改成功；不本地预设已授权；危险操作非默认回车

recipes.name: ModelAndUsage
recipes.usage: 模型能力、上下文占用、账号配额是三个不同指标；无分母显示未知
recipes.prohibited: 不沿用参考的固定Claude型号；不用上下文占用冒充额度；锁定能力由后端提供

recipes.name: SessionRow
recipes.api: SessionRow(id, title, group, selected, status, on_action)
recipes.usage: 稳定ID、持久选中、4pt拖拽门槛、取消回滚、分组可配置
recipes.prohibited: 不随视觉迁移默默合并文件夹；不让hover覆盖selected

recipes.name: ArtifactPreview
recipes.usage: 代码/预览/差异切换；窗口不足时切成可切换面板
recipes.prohibited: 通用控件不执行不可信内容；WebView权限由消费者沙箱管理

recipes.name: PopoutWorkspace
recipes.usage: 可选消费者能力；按稳定session共享状态，跨窗口恢复焦点和未发草稿
recipes.prohibited: 不建立第二份业务真源；后台窗口不抢焦点；不宣称已实现

recipes.name: AgentTaskBoard
recipes.usage: 可选消费者看板；任务、产物与验证结果分别呈现
recipes.prohibited: 不把执行完成显示为验证通过；不嵌入agent执行器到通用crate

ime.escape_during_composition: IME handles first; do not dismiss ancestor dialog
ime.send_ack_rule: persist immutable draft/outbox entry before submission; clear the matching draft only after durable acceptance; idempotency key required for retry

drag.cancel: Escape/lost capture/window deactivation restore initial ratio and release capture
drag.clamp_rule: apply content minima first; if infeasible collapse into switchable panels; never produce minRatio > maxRatio

scroll.unpin: any user upward intent immediately enters reading-history, even within tolerance
scroll.repin: explicit jump-to-latest or user intentionally returns to bottom; never by timer alone
scroll.stream_reveal: append without blur or glyph motion

craft_review.scope: Tekes local review contract inspired by cited perspectives, not their verbatim requirements
craft_review.authority: approved Tekes design release; external posts are references only

checks.title: 实际体验而非流程完成度
checks.criterion: 从导航到核心任务操作完整走查；组件/截图/文档数量不能替代任务完成质量。

checks.title: 探索与发布分离
checks.criterion: 草图、AI原型和正式实现清楚标识；发布使用批准源与真实组件，探索顺序可以变化。

checks.title: 确定的控件状态与不确定的生成内容
checks.criterion: 相同输入事件产生确定UI状态；空/长/畸形/延迟/中断/失败内容分别使用夹具，不要求穷举模型回答。

checks.title: 渐进披露不隐藏必要信息
checks.criterion: 技术细节按需展开；待批准动作、权限范围、错误、取消与证据状态持续可达。

checks.title: 品牌与反馈的任务价值
checks.criterion: 品牌变化遵守语义边界；反馈不靠颜色独占表达，不以光晕、shimmer或无关动画制造活跃感。

checks.title: 真实行为和视觉细节一起审查
checks.criterion: 焦点、IME、复制/撤销、滚动锚点与响应预算同基线回归，不只比较静态画面。

checks.title: 反馈驱动且可追溯
checks.criterion: 区分用户观察、AI总结和设计决定；记录依据、负责人、批准版本与改动影响。

craft_review.scenario_note: Inputs are case specifications, not model behavior guarantees or completed tests.
